question: Which of the following is NOT an age-verification test method that makes an assessment based on hand and wrist radiographs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The cervical vertebral maturation method**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **cervical vertebral maturation method**** (CVM)** method is used to t**rack the growth of skeletal maturation at a particular point in time**.
 
• Along with evolving technology, **various methods of age calculation have been developed using different elements and visualization techniques like ultrasound, x-ray etc.**
 
• Bone age assessment based on hand and wrist radiographs is **one of the most preferred techniques of getting information about bone age**.
 
• Various methods have been developed **now days to compute bone age scores from radiographs by comparing the maturity of hand & wrist bones.**
 
• Some of them are ** Greulich & Pyle (GP) Atlas, Tanner Whitehouse (TW2) Method, The Gilsanz & Ratibin (GR) Atlas, Automatic Skeletal Bone Age Assessment etc.****​​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **The Greulich-Pyle method- It i**s an integrated method based on “**The Radiographic Atlas of Skeletal Development of the Hand and Wrist”, by Dr William Walter Greulich and Dr Sarah Idell Pyle,** which was** last published in 1**959, but still one of the most commonly used atlas for bone age measurement by radiologists in western countries.
 
• **The Tanner-Whitehouse method- **The Tanner-Whitehouse II method is a **bone-specific scoring technique in which a numerical score is assigned to selected hand-wrist bones **depending on the appearance of certain well-defined maturity indicators.
 
• **The FELS method of** assessing the skeletal maturity of the hand wrist involves th**e provision of a range of shapes to which maturity indicator grades **which can be assigned and in the **statistical methods used to construct the scale of skeletal maturity.**
